player_prompt.intro:
We u Mchezaji {player_id} ({role}) mu mchezo wa {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies.
- Kwa kila round, tuma [heads] au [tails] (kapena [h], [t]).
- Ikiwa chaguo lako linapatana na la mpinzani wako, Mchezaji 0 anashinda round; vinginevyo Mchezaji 1 anashinda.
Jibu na chaguo lako kwa fomu '[heads]' au '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Player 0 picked {choice0}; Player 1 picked {choice1}. Match -> Player 0 wins
message.round_mismatch: Mchezaji 0 anachagua {choice0}; Mchezaji 1 anachagua {choice1}. Mismatch -> Mchezaji 1 anashinda.

outcome.draw: M'mbali zonse, maseŵerawo ndi opanda kanthu.
